subject: Tufts Institutional Zone Zoning Proposals
overview: The committee met to receive a presentation from Innes Associates on zoning options for the Tufts Institutional Zone and discussed a proposed timeline and path forward for the city's broader rezoning project.

items.title: Council President's Statement on Rezoning Timeline
items.summary: Council President Zac Bears proposed a schedule to prioritize commercial and institutional zoning updates this year while extending the review of residential districts and parking requirements into 2026.

items.title: Tufts Institutional Zone Presentation
items.summary: Innes Associates presented research on Dover Amendment case law and institutional zoning models from other Massachusetts communities to guide the development of a Tufts Institutional Zone in Medford.

items.title: Public Comment
items.summary: Residents spoke on topics including student housing capacity, campus retail uses, building heights, parking minimums, and the impact of university expansion on abutting residential neighborhoods.

items.title: Committee Action
items.summary: The committee approved a motion to keep the paper in committee.
